name: tourer-travel
description: Private airport and intercity transfer prices across Turkey with booking links, service information and management of your own Tourer bookings.

interface.longDescription:
Tourer Travel is a Turkish ground transportation company that runs private airport transfers and intercity rides across Turkey at fixed prices.

With this app, ChatGPT can help you plan a private transfer anywhere in Turkey. Name an airport, hotel, city or address and a date, time and number of passengers, and ChatGPT finds the places, then lists the vehicles that fit your group with the total price for each one. Prices include tolls, and round trip prices cover both legs. Paid extras such as child seats are listed with their prices. When you choose a vehicle, you get a link that opens a prefilled booking page on tourertravel.com, where you check the details and pay. Nothing is booked or charged inside ChatGPT.

You can also ask about cancellation and refund rules, payment methods, airport waiting time, luggage, child seats, meet and greet, contact details and the service area.

If you already have a Tourer account, you can link it to see your upcoming and past bookings, open the details of a booking including the driver once one is assigned, and cancel a booking. Cancelling always shows the refund outcome first and needs your confirmation. Cancellation access is a separate permission that you choose when you link your account.

The app covers all 81 provinces of Turkey and only operates within Turkey, so Northern Cyprus and other countries are not served. Vehicles are private and never shared. Prices can be shown in Turkish lira, euro, US dollar or pound sterling.
defaultPrompt: Price a transfer from Istanbul Airport to Taksim for 2 people next Friday at 14:00
What is Tourer's free cancellation window?

positive.description: Price a one way airport transfer
positive.prompt: How much is a private transfer from Istanbul Airport to Taksim Square on 20 December 2026 at 14:00 for 2 adults with 2 suitcases? Show prices in EUR.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves both places with coordinates, then lists the available vehicles with total price in EUR, passenger and luggage capacity and a tourertravel.com booking link for each. Nothing is booked.

positive.description: Price a round trip with a child seat
positive.prompt: Quote a round trip from Antalya Airport to Kemer for 2 adults and 1 child aged 3, arriving 5 December 2026 at 15:30 and returning 12 December 2026 at 10:00. Add a child seat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns round trip prices covering both legs with the child seat included in each price, lists the selected extra and gives a booking link per vehicle.

positive.prompt: What is Tourer's cancellation and refund policy, and how long does the driver wait at the airport?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the published cancellation, refund and waiting time rules as stated by Tourer, without inventing terms.

positive.description: List bookings of the linked test account
positive.expected_behavior: After the reviewer links the test account, lists the two upcoming sample bookings BK9910000000000001 (Istanbul Airport to Taksim, 20 Nov 2026) and BK9910000000000002 (Antalya Airport to Kemer, round trip).

positive.description: Check and cancel a test booking with confirmation
positive.prompt: Can I cancel booking BK9910000000000001? If it is free, cancel it.
positive.expected_behavior: First runs cancel_booking with dry_run and reports the deadline and that no payment was taken, then asks for confirmation; only after the user confirms it cancels with confirm true and reports the booking as cancelled.

negative.description: Transfer outside Turkey is out of scope. The app should say it only covers Turkey and not return a price.
negative.prompt: Book me a private transfer from Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport to the Eiffel Tower tomorrow.

negative.description: Payment cannot be taken in chat. The app should not collect card details and should point to the booking link on tourertravel.com.
negative.prompt: Here is my credit card number, pay for the cheapest vehicle from Antalya Airport to Belek right now.

negative.description: Unrelated request. The app should not be used for flights or hotels.
negative.prompt: Find me a cheap flight from London to Istanbul and a hotel in Sultanahmet.

review.commerce_description: The app shows prices for private ground transfer services in Turkey and returns links to a booking page on tourertravel.com. Booking and payment happen only on tourertravel.com. No payment, card data or checkout happens inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: place search in Turkey, private transfer prices with booking links, service information, and optional account linking to list, view and cancel your own bookings.
